cup.message: FPL creates the mini-league cup automatically. Fixtures appear here as soon as the draw is made (usually around GW34).

auto.headline: Neil Rose is August's Manager of the Month with 202 points.
bullets: Neil Rose took the month by 16 points. Comfortable.
108 points separated first from last (Neil Rose 202, Stuart Gibbons 94), with the league averaging 143.4.
The league left 436 points on the bench this month. Neil Macdougall accounted for 33 of them.
16 points went up in smoke on transfer hits. Tom Stuffins took 8 of that on the chin.
Chips played: Neil Rose (Bench Boost), Shannon Engelbrecht (Bench Boost), Steve Darbin (Bench Boost), Liam Addis (Bench Boost), Nick Holt (Bench Boost).
Captain of the month award goes to Zach Mettee, who handed the armband to Thiago for a 0-point return in GW1.
Most-captained in GW2: Haaland (51% of the league).

written._readme: Hand-written monthly round-ups. Keyed by month (YYYY-MM). Whatever is here replaces the auto-generated commentary on the Email round-up tab. Each entry takes either 'body_html' (rich, recommended) or 'body' (plain text, blank line between paragraphs). Claude drops a new entry in here each month; you never need to touch it.
